theorems.name: Submission.idtp_fons_cc_cycle_rescale
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (S : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n) (R : IMRep (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n) (y : Euclid P) (t : ℝ), 1 ≤ n → 0 < t → IsMinimizingIn S univ → BoundaryVanishes S → R.Represents S → ∃ (S' : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n) (R' : IMRep (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n), IsMinimizingIn S' univ ∧ BoundaryVanishes S' ∧ R'.Represents S' ∧ R'.measure = ENNReal.ofReal (t⁻¹ ^ n) • R.measure.map (dilation y t)
